2023-3755-4518-7060.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-4976--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-4976--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

132-3263-4687-7013.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-3263-4687-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-3263-4687-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-3263-4687-7013.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

1957-3845-4050--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Panicked Bystander or Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-4699.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5147-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-7396.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-4832-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6822-7061.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Solid Ground
Repeat.

670-1619-2511-3175-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-2511-3175-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-2511-3175-4681.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-2511-3175-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

647-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
647-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
647-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-7436.description:
Activate Pest Mascot by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Pest Mascot triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1305-6575-7175.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7159.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1651-3875-4935-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-4935-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-4935-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4772-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1796-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1796-2034-3693-5224.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to cast Walking Ballista, and then remove counters from it to deal damage.

2173-2438-3661-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2811-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2167-5626-5721-6662.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-6662.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2178-2511-2857.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2511-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2511-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2178-2511-2857.notes: You may instead target another nontoken creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur.

4598-5195-5913.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Pinnacle Monk.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

678-2639-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mitotic Slime, adding {G}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it and Enduring Renewal triggers.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating  two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {2}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Oozes, adding {2}.
Cast Mitotic Slime by paying {4}{G}.
Repeat.

3263-4365-4853-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating four 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Constructs.
When the Constructs die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger from step 7, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Mondrak ability from step 6, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-2136.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
1636-2136.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any other creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1594-2034-3874-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Armory Automaton.
1594-2034-3874-5222.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Armory Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Armory Automaton dies, triggering Sword of the Realms, returning Armory Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Armory Automaton by paying {2}.
Armory Automaton enters the battlefield, attaching Sword of the Realms to it.
Repeat.

2440-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type, one of which must be a nontoken creature.
2440-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature that shares a creature type with at least two other creatures you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
If there are four more creatures that share the creature type, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

225-433-539-907.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
